text_markup: If the first subroutine on {card:Fairchild 2.0} resolves while the Runner has no installed cards but 3[c], then the Runner must choose to pay 2[c]. When the second subroutine on {card:Fairchild 2.0} resolves, the Runner can neither pay 2[c] nor trash an installed card, so nothing happens.
